content.introduction: According to TechCrunch, Microsoft has released new AI PCs with Nvidia chips and revamped Windows 11. Meta's Muse has launched on iPad a month after its mobile debut, and X has expanded its 'Gametime' sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB. ABC News reports on Andrew Yang's lack of 'high hopes' for AI regulation and a new AI robot named Taku that can load washers, fold towels, and stock shelves. GeekWire covers the launch of a service by Foundations to connect businesses with AI founders for hire, and the acquisition of Seattle voice AI startup Ultravox by Inworld. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to specific questions about official websites or phone numbers.
